messages:
josh: Heads up — preflight eval for the summarizer bump failed the prompt suite. Can we hold the canary? :warning:

deploybot: PREDEPLOY CHECK FAILED for release/summarizer-2.0 -> gate:prompt-eval
  failing_tests: 3 | noise_regression > 0.02 | action: HOLD (auto)

sara: Ugh, I'm seeing a consistent drop on the user-facing QA prompts. Quick numbers: mean_f1 down ~3.1% vs baseline. Not just noise.
maria: Thanks. Are these regressions concentrated on long-context cases or hallucination categories? We need to know if it's safety or quality.
sara: Looks like long-context truncation + hallucination in instruction-following for >1024 tokens. Short queries look fine.
tom: If it's long-context, that impacts streaming customers and latency SLOs too. We should prevent rollout to Dedicated until we triage.
anya: I pulled the eval diffs:```
Preflight extract:
- prompt-suite/summarizer_v2 -> mean_answer_score: 0.912 (baseline 0.945) delta -0.033
- hallucination_rate: 0.078 (baseline 0.021) delta +0.057
- safety_signals: OK
```

josh: Not great. Two options: pin the canary traffic to summarizer-1.9 and hotfix + re-run suite, or roll back the canary entirely and revert the model bump in prod release. Thoughts?
maria: I lean pin+hotfix. Rolling back across regions is heavier and will affect scheduled change window. Also gives us time to split test fixes.
sara: Pin is ok if we can guarantee no partial routing leak. How confident are we that routing policy will respect pin for all canary hosts?
tom: Ops: we can pin via routing policy for the canary slice and set automatic fallback to 1.9 on mismatch. I'll patch the route in 10m and run smoke.
deploybot: ACTION: routing.pin applied -> service=summarizer, pinned_version=1.9, scope=canary_slice

josh: Good. Also create a rollback ticket in case the hotfix doesn't pass: PROJ-7321 created. Assigning to sara and eng-ml.
anya: I'll start a focused eval with longer-context prompts and a smaller beam search to see if quantization/kv-cache mismatch is the root cause.
sara: I'll draft a short release note entry for the hold and update the public changelog: "Postponed summarizer model bump due to regressions; preserving current version for stability."
maria: Schedule: pin now, full triage today, target hotfix patch by EOD. If hotfix fails, escalate to rollback and schedule a release revert in the next change window.
josh: Approvals: @product (cc @ops) — do we want to proceed with pin path?
maria: product signoff verbalized in #product-briefing. :thumbsup:

tom: Running smoke on canary after pin. Will report back in 15.
anna: (note) add test case IDs to the ticket: prompt-suite/long-context-12, prompt-suite/halluc-07.

sara: Thanks, team. I'll put the eval screenshots + sample diffs in PROJ-7321 and flag for an expedited hotfix cycle.
josh: OK — holding promotion. Will update release notes and mark the releasebot gate as blocked until green. :lock:

deploybot: GATE STATE: BLOCKED -> reason: prompt-eval regression -> ticket=PROJ-7321 -> actions=[pin_to_1.9, notify-eng, notify-product]

tom: Smoke looks clean on pinned route. No increased error rates.
josh: Great. Closing this thread for now — we reconvene after the focused evals. Thanks all.
